payload.summary: Live search's query embedding can wait 45 s and retry twice, the same 45 s the browser allows, so a slow OpenAI reply fails the search instead of falling back to keyword results
payload.detail: embedTextWithTelemetry (src/lib/openai.ts) uses requestOptions with no per-call timeout, so it takes OPENAI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS (45000, src/lib/env.ts:172) and OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES (2) via defaultMaxRetries (openai.ts:189). Callers on the interactive path (src/lib/rag/rag.ts around 1364 and 1703, rag-governed-search.ts:120) pass only the request signal. The browser search budget is searchRequestTimeoutMs = 45_000 (src/components/clinical-dashboard/search-utils.ts:423), so one slow embedding call always exhausts the user's whole budget. Next action: give the interactive query embedding its own short deadline (a few seconds, no retry) and let search continue on the lexical/text path when it expires, with telemetry. The caller side is a RAG-protected surface: flag before editing; a fallback-path change may need a canary pair.
